```yaml
name: Pre‑Checkout Cleanup

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Clean workspace before checkout
        run: |
          echo "Removing previous build artifacts and caches..."
          # Remove Rust build artifacts
          rm -rf target
          # Remove Rust toolchain caches
          rm -rf ~/.cargo
          rm -rf ~/.rustup
          # Remove Python byte‑code caches
          find . -type d -name "__pycache__" -exec rm -rf {} +
          # Remove any leftover Docker images or containers (non‑root)
          docker ps -aq | xargs -r docker rm -f
          docker images -q | xargs -r docker rmi -f
        shell: bash
```
